author: Lukiethewesly13; derivative animation/preparation: Prehistoric Animal Museum contributors
title: Mosasaurus
modifications: Prehistoric Animal Museum contributors: Compressed geometry and animation with high-precision Meshopt and converted embedded PNG textures to lossless WebP for browser delivery. Freeze the reviewed source pose and, when eligible, a source-rig partial mouth-close target before making morph animation deterministic. Operation: bake-and-join. Replaced the source tail morph's sign-reversing S curve with two mirrored, length-preserving single-curvature arc targets. Each stroke now begins at the muscular tail root, increases continuously toward the tip, and returns through a neutral straight pose without folding back on itself; retained the symmetric four-flipper swimming targets. Cleared stale normalized flags after promoting repaired morph and animation accessors to floating point so the runtime GLTF loader receives spec-valid data.
